readerCopy.body: The sentence everyone keeps deleting can become the sentence the entire conversation is already organized around. When Mercury conjoins Lilith, language and refusal fuse, making an embarrassing detail, unpopular opinion, difficult question, or blunt truth harder to keep outside the discussion. Silence does not remove the subject; it makes everyone manage it indirectly. The useful sentence changes the meaning of the conversation without needing extra harshness to prove that it is honest.
